caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical jar sketched in thin black lines against a beige background. The jar is positioned at the lower center of the image and features a simple double rim at its open top. Written near the top of the jar are the words "PLUMBS" and there is a small shell-like motif beneath the text, both rendered in black ink with the shell motif lightly shaded in blue. Above the jar, occupying the upper half of the drawing, is a large rectangular grayish-brown shaded area. Within this shaded area, on the left side, are the words "C. CROLIUS MANUFACTURER MANHATTAN-WELLS NEW-YORK." in black capital letters, some of which appear slightly skewed or irregular in alignment. On the right side of the shaded area, the word "PLUMBS" is typed in all caps, and directly beneath it is a larger version of the same shell motif, colored in blue and outlined in black. In the lower left corner of the drawing, the signature "F. HUMAGALLI" appears in small, neat capital letters.
title: Preserve Jar
